route_guardian_loader.label: PMP Current Route Guardian Loader v13 with fixed Add-on Loader v1

current_app.label: PMP Current v4 migration wrapper over v3 app

user_facing_rule: Only show PMP Current / PMP-CURRENT-1 as the app version.
home_screen_rule: Install pmp-app-current.html once. It is a stable map-driven door and should change as little as possible.
update_rule: Route Guardian v13 opens the current app only after the user presses Open Latest App. It prepares Private Window support scripts, Source Router, archive-first cleanup, manifest-alignment saving, and fixed-slot Add-on Loader v1, but does not open Private Window automatically.
